forecast_authority_leakage_findings.FUNCTION_OR_PATH: Task8 persisted availability binding at the Task9 application and replay-pipeline boundaries
forecast_authority_leakage_findings.CURRENT_BEHAVIOR: Exact replay requires persisted Task8 availability, loads MaturityDailyPredictionModel.created_at, injects it into trusted source-ref and verification evidence, and checks it against the exact forecast cutoff.

forecast_authority_leakage_findings.FUNCTION_OR_PATH: Shared persisted Weather supplemental authority binding for residual training and prediction
forecast_authority_leakage_findings.CURRENT_BEHAVIOR: Both residual training and prediction invoke the shared weather_authority.py binder. Weather values require an explicit weather_feature_run_id, reload a persisted completed WeatherFeatureRun, require observation-date parity, and bind source signature, feature/config/mapping/source versions from the persisted run. Existing caller known_at/source_available_at checks remain exact-cutoff visibility controls.
forecast_authority_leakage_findings.LEAKAGE_VECTOR: Closed: missing, unknown, or non-completed WeatherFeatureRun IDs, omitted or future/mismatched observation dates, mismatched persisted provenance, and cross-run provenance mixing fail closed. WeatherFeatureRun.finished_at is not used as historical business availability.
forecast_authority_leakage_findings.REQUIRED_MINIMUM_FIX: Closed by merged PR #194; retain explicit persisted WeatherFeatureRun authority, shared training/prediction enforcement, exact caller timestamp visibility, and fail-closed parity checks.
forecast_authority_leakage_findings.TEST_REQUIRED: Current-main Weather authority, training-manifest, prediction-application, and visibility regressions covering valid persisted binding, missing/unknown/non-completed runs, date and provenance mismatches, cross-run mixing, post-cutoff timestamps, and equality boundary.

forecast_authority_leakage_findings.FUNCTION_OR_PATH: Shared persisted Planning supplemental authority binding for residual training and prediction
forecast_authority_leakage_findings.CURRENT_BEHAVIOR: Both residual training and prediction invoke the shared planning_authority.py binder. It reloads an explicit FarmSeasonVarietyPlan, selects exactly one effective as-of row, validates identity/version/row hash/scope and effective interval, and retains the caller category because the persisted row has no destination_factory_category column.
forecast_authority_leakage_findings.LEAKAGE_VECTOR: Closed: generic caller-only plan timestamps cannot substitute a later, different, or non-effective persisted plan.
forecast_authority_leakage_findings.REQUIRED_MINIMUM_FIX: Closed by merged PR #200; retain explicit as-of plan identity/version/hash/scope binding and fail-closed multiple-effective-plan behavior.
forecast_authority_leakage_findings.TEST_REQUIRED: Current-main planning authority tests cover persisted reload, identity tampering, effective-plan conflict, and later/not-effective plan rejection.

forecast_authority_leakage_findings.FUNCTION_OR_PATH: Residual prediction request and model artifact loading
forecast_authority_leakage_findings.CURRENT_BEHAVIOR: Loads explicit model_run_id and task9_run_id; non-replay training/artifact timestamps are checked against the exact cutoff, while replay-trained requests use persisted Task12 training/label authority and canonical manifest/dataset revalidation.
forecast_authority_leakage_findings.LEAKAGE_VECTOR: Closed: no latest/current substitution is used; replay-trained artifacts are accepted after the forecast cutoff only through persisted replay authority whose training cutoff, persisted rows, labels, hashes, and Task9 identity are checked.
forecast_authority_leakage_findings.REQUIRED_MINIMUM_FIX: Closed by merged PR #192; retain explicit-ID loading, persisted replay provenance, exact cutoff binding, and fail-closed hash/row/label checks.
forecast_authority_leakage_findings.TEST_REQUIRED: Current-main replay-trained and prediction-authority regressions cover persisted manifest/config/dataset mismatch, future training rows, future label availability, and valid replay preservation.

forecast_authority_leakage_findings.FUNCTION_OR_PATH: Exact forecast cutoff resolution and residual FeatureValue visibility
forecast_authority_leakage_findings.CURRENT_BEHAVIOR: Replay resolves HarvestStateRun.forecast_effective_cutoff_at, passes the exact cutoff to prediction/training visibility, and rejects known_at or source_available_at after it.
forecast_authority_leakage_findings.LEAKAGE_VECTOR: Closed: same-day post-cutoff FeatureValue timestamps are rejected while equality remains visible; legacy EOD exists only for non-replay runs without persisted cutoff.
forecast_authority_leakage_findings.REQUIRED_MINIMUM_FIX: Closed by PR #189; exact cutoff propagation and post-cutoff rejection are covered by current code/tests.

forecast_authority_leakage_findings.FUNCTION_OR_PATH: Residual model artifact historical availability authority

forecast_authority_leakage_findings.LEAKAGE_VECTOR: Closed: persisted replay manifest rows and labels are bounded by a training cutoff no later than the exact forecast cutoff, with persisted manifest/config/dataset hashes revalidated; no generic future artifact fallback is allowed.

forecast_authority_leakage_findings.TEST_REQUIRED: Current-main regression coverage rejects future training rows and future label availability, detects persisted manifest/config/dataset mismatch, and preserves the valid replay path.
